title: factor_table.v1 - PROVA DA BUTTARE
description: PROVA DA BUTTARE (S12r2, ADR-0029): tabella dei fattori di uno studio, scritta dal modello dalla vista dello studio. Schema v1 secondo la spec par. 5.2, aggiornamento 2026-11-10: prima i fattori, poi i ruoli delle sole colonne che non sono fonte di un fattore; assegnazione a condizioni nominate; livelli riservati 'not stated' e 'not applicable'; valori mancanti delle colonne di soggetto. I confronti li forma il costruttore deterministico tf_confronti(), non il modello. Non sta in inst/schemas/ e non entra nel pacchetto.

series_id.description: the GEO series accession, as written in the first line of the input

factors.description: one entry per factor of the design

type.description: perturbation: something that the experimenter applies or changes, including a culture condition that the series varies; state: a property of the donor that the experimenter does not apply; context: cell line, cell type, tissue; time; technical: a measurement variable that divides the samples into a few groups (batch, platform, kit, run, centre)

source_columns.description: the columns of the SAMPLE TABLE from which the levels of this factor are read

levels.description: the levels of this factor; the special levels 'not stated' and 'not applicable' are not listed here

level.description: short name of the level, unique within the factor

text_as_written.description: the text that states this level, as written in the metadata

entity.description: name of the agent (perturbation) or of the disease or genotype (state); empty string for the other types; a name, never an ontology identifier

dose.description: dose or concentration with its unit, if written; empty string otherwise

duration.description: duration of the treatment with its unit, if written; empty string otherwise

baseline_level.description: the level that is the baseline of this factor; empty string if the factor has no baseline; always empty for types context, time and technical

baseline_evidence.description: quotation from the input text that supports the baseline; empty string if baseline_level is empty

assignment.description: the samples of each level, given by conditions on the source columns; every sample of the series meets the conditions of the entries of exactly one level

when.description: the conditions of this entry; a sample has the level of this entry when it meets all of them; one condition is the common case

column.description: one of the source_columns of this factor, copied character by character

value.description: one distinct value of that column, copied character by character from the SAMPLE TABLE; an empty cell is the empty string

level.description: the level of this factor for the samples that meet the conditions: one of the names in levels, or 'not stated', or 'not applicable'

other_columns.description: one entry for every column of the SAMPLE TABLE, except gsm, that is not a source column of a factor

column.description: column name, copied character by character from the header of the SAMPLE TABLE

subject_kind.description: for role subject: what the column identifies; empty string for every other role

missing_values.description: for role subject: the values of this column that mean that the datum is missing in this series; empty array if there are none and for every other role

not_understood.description: samples or values that could not be assigned; empty array if there are none

what.description: the samples, the column or the values that could not be assigned
